PUBLIC COMMENTS
The public is encouraged to address the Planning Commission on items listed on this agenda on any matter posted on the agenda or on any other matter within its jurisdiction. If you wish to address the City Council or any of its Agencies, you may do so during the PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS period noted on the agenda. Each person is allowed three (3) minutes speaking time. A Spanish speaking interpreter is available for your convenience.
COMENTARIOS DEL PUBLICO
Se invita al público a dirigirse al Concilio o cualquiera otra de sus Agencias nombradas en esta agenda, para hablar sobre cualquier asunto publicado en la agenda o cualquier tema que esté bajo su jurisdicción. Si usted desea la oportunidad de dirigirse al Concilio o alguna de sus Agencias, podrá hacerlo durante el período de Comentarios del Público (Public Communications) anunciado en la agenda. A cada persona se le permite hablar por tres (3) minutos. Hay un intérprete para su conveniencia.

2)
A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR THE MODIFICATION OF AN EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY TO INCLUDE THE REPLACEMENT OF SIX (6) EXISTING ANTENNA PANELS AND THE ADDITION OF SIX (6) REMOTE RADIO UNITS ON A 63' TALL WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS FACILITY IN THE FORM OF A MONOPOLE AND A NEW DECORATIVE WALL TO SCREEN THE EQUIPMENT SHELTER, PURSUANT TO SECTION 153.180.040 (B) (3) OF THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE (LOCATION: 12911-12921 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: LAUREL REIMER, WITH CORE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES FOR VERIZON WIRELESS; CASE NO.: CP-808). Staff recommends that following the public hearing, the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC 13-24 entitled "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT AND APPROVING A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW THE MODIFICATION OF AN EXISTING UNSTEALTHED WIRELESS COMMUNICATIONS FACILITY IN THE FORM OF A MONOPOLE (LOCATION: 12911-12921 GARVEY AVENUE; APPLICANT: LAUREL REIMER, WITH CORE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES, REPRESENTING VERIZON WIRELESS; CASE NO.: CP-808)".
STAFF REPORT

A REQUEST FOR CONSIDERATION OF A ZONE VARIANCE TO ALLOW: (1) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED GARAGE PARKING SPACES FOR A NEW SINGLE-FAMILY DWELLING UNIT; (2) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED SECOND STORY SIDE YARD SETBACK; (3) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED BUILDING WIDTH FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NEW SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DWELLING UNIT WITHIN THE R-1 ZONE. (LOCATION: 14611 BALDWIN AVENUE; APPLICANT: DANNY SABBAGH; CASE NO.: ZV-708) Staff recommends that following the public hearing the Planning Commission adopt Resolution PC 13-25 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK ADOPTING THE FINDINGS OF FACT APPROVING A ZONE VARIANCE ALLOWING: (1) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED NUMBER OF GARAGE SPACES FOR A NEW DWELLING UNIT; (2) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED BUILDING WIDTH FOR A DWELLING UNIT; AND (3) LESS THAN THE MINIMUM REQUIRED SECOND STORY SETBACK FOR A NEW SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE (LOCATION: 14611 BALDWIN AVENUE; APPLICANT: DANNY SABBAGH; CASE NO.: ZV-708)".
